label: Bible Study
prompt: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his _____, and follow me.
verse: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
note: Deny, take up, follow — spoken right after Peter tried to talk Jesus out of the cross.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he _____ us:
verse: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
note: John's confidence about prayer: ask according to God's will, and He hears.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there were in the same country shepherds _____ in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
verse: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
note: The first Christmas announcement went to night-shift shepherds, abiding in the field with their flock.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Be ye not as the horse, or as the _____, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verse: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
note: Don't be a mule that needs bit and bridle to go where it's told — learn to come willingly.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: What shall I _____ unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
verse: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
note: The grateful psalmist asks what he can 'render' for all God's benefits. His answer (v. 13): take the cup of salvation.
